summary: d2 moves from 0.8.1 to 0.8.2, and a note is now charged for the arrow line it actually hides rather than for the bounding box it sits inside. Whole-sample-set time is down about 6% with every count unchanged; one inspection costs 16% more, which is the new sampling.
why: A route is sampled along its length inside the browser instead of being intersected as a bounding box, once per note per layout candidate. A route whose whole extent misses the note is ruled out before any sampling, which is what keeps the cost to a fraction of an inspection.
